note: Mechanisms are kept SEPARATE from Evidence Sets (Fresco). An Evidence Set holds only candidate_mechanisms: [MC-...] links; this registry aggregates, per mechanism, its supporting evidence sets, the relevant decisions, and the engineering rules derived from it. A mechanism is promoted only when a criterion recurs across real decisions (decision_library) — born from data, not impression.
